title: Design: Edit Customer shows Internal customer and Default internal category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-17-11-edit-customer-min-without.png, iwo-happy-08-08-edit-customer-internal-customer.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customer page opens.

Step 2:

  • The Edit Customer window opens; its last field, below "PO is required", is the ticked checkbox "Internal customer" with the helper "Work orders for this customer are internal: no prices, no invoice, parts cost posts to the expense account of the internal category."
  • Under it the select "Default internal category" shows the customer's category (General Internal unless changed).
  • The Min shop supplies field can be filled although no shop supplies percentage is set.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories), story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S1-R7: “Edit Customer shows the checkbox "Internal customer" as the last field of the dialog, below "PO is required", with the helper "Work orders for this customer are internal: no prices, no invoice, parts cost posts to the expense account of the internal category." When ticked, the select "Default internal category" appears under it, listing the active Internal categories, General Internal preselected. It is shown while the setting is on (S1-N4 for the exception). New Customer does not show it: a customer is flagged after it exists, from Edit Customer or the modal. The checkbox and the modal are the only places the flag is set; ticking it on Save flags the customer (with the dialog of S1-R11 when open billable work orders exist).”
  • S10-R1: “On a flagged customer, Edit Customer accepts the Min without a shop supplies percentage (today Min is disabled until a percentage is entered); a percentage, if set, never applies to internal or no-charge work orders.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 0 · Turn it on" / "Happy flow v6", boards "11 Edit Customer · Min without %" (Flow 0 · Turn it on), "08 Edit Customer · Internal customer" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow0-17-11-edit-customer-min-without.png
  • iwo-happy-08-08-edit-customer-internal-customer.png

The design's own words:

  • “Internal customer”
  • “Default internal category”

Difference: design boards 05 and 08 draw the checkbox with an info icon and no helper, and without the select: register IWO-D06, settled by S1-R7.
